teaser.en: Brush against its pods and you will be scratching for hours: the hairs on this bean cause intense itching.
teaser.sw: Ukigusana na maganda yake utajikuna kwa saa nyingi: manyoya ya kunde hii husababisha mwasho mkali.
teaser.dg: Uchinyenyeza makakayage, undakala uchidzikuna kpwa masaa manji: nyere za kunde hinyu zinahenda mwiri uawiwe sana.

summary.en: *Uphupu* is the velvet bean, a vigorous climber with dark purple flowers and pods coated in stinging hairs. Its pods are best admired from a distance.
summary.sw: *Uphupu* ni upupu (*velvet bean*), mtambaa wenye nguvu wenye maua ya zambarau iliyokolea na maganda yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya yanayowasha. Maganda yake ni bora kuyatazama ukiwa mbali.
summary.dg: *Uphupu* ni kunde ya weruni inayokpwera kpwa nguvu, yenye maruwa ga zambarau nyiru na makakaya ganayofwinikpwa ni nyere zinazoawisa. Makakayage ni ga kulola kula kure.

about.en:
*Uphupu* is a vigorous climbing bean that can smother shrubs and small trees. Its leaves have three broad leaflets, like most beans.

The flowers are dark purple and hang in long sprays. They are followed by curved pods covered in dense golden-brown or orange hairs. These hairs break off easily and cause intense itching on skin.
about.sw:
*Uphupu* ni mtambaa wa jamii ya kunde wenye nguvu unaoweza kufunika vichaka na miti midogo. Majani yake yana vijani vitatu vipana, kama kunde nyingi.

Maua ni ya zambarau iliyokolea na huning'inia katika mashada marefu. Hufuatiwa na maganda yaliyopinda, yaliyofunikwa kwa manyoya mazito ya rangi ya kahawia-dhahabu au ya chungwa. Manyoya haya hukatika kwa urahisi na kusababisha mwasho mkali kwenye ngozi.
about.dg:
*Uphupu* ni kunde inayokpwera kpwa nguvu, inayoweza kufwinika vitsaka na mihi midide. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu mapana, dza kunde nyinji.

Maruwage ni ga zambarau nyiru na ganabwadzika mabunda marefu. Bada yakpwe kunatuluka makakaya garigotsongbwa, ganayofwinikpwa ni nyere nyinji za rangi ya dongo na zahabu au za rangi ya chungbwa. Nyere hizo zinadoka upesi na zinahenda ngozi iawiwe sana.

where.en: Look for *uphupu* in bush and on forest edges, climbing over other plants. The hairy pods are easiest to see as they ripen after the rains.
where.sw: Mtafute *uphupu* vichakani na kando ya misitu, ukipanda juu ya mimea mingine. Maganda yenye manyoya ni rahisi zaidi kuonekana yanapoiva baada ya mvua.
where.dg: Hendza *uphupu* weruni na kanda-kanda ya matsaka, ichikpwera dzulu ya mimea yanjina. Makakaya genye nyere ni rahisi kugaona ganaphokala maivu bada ya mvula.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded. Elsewhere, cultivated forms of the velvet bean are grown as cover crops and the seeds, after careful processing, are eaten.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa. Kwingineko, aina zinazopandwa za upupu hulimwa kama mazao ya kufunika udongo, na mbegu, baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu, huliwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu. Kpwa tsi zanjina, aina za kunde hino zinazophandwa nkurimwa ili kufwinika tsi, na tembeze, bada ya kutengezwa sawa-sawa, nkuriwa.

names.en: Digo: *uphupu*. English: velvet bean, buffalo bean or cowitch. In Swahili it is *upupu*. Scientists call it *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* means 'itching'.
names.sw: Kidigo: *uphupu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *velvet bean*, *buffalo bean* au *cowitch*. Kwa Kiswahili ni *upupu*. Wanasayansi huuita *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* linamaanisha 'kuwasha'.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *uphupu*. Kpwa Chingereza inaihwa *velvet bean*, *buffalo bean* au *cowitch*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *upupu*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Mucuna pruriens*; *pruriens* manage ni 'kuawiwa'.
